topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well, I never thought I'd be on the other side of this kind of case. Turns out, my old lady's been scribbling away, weaving our life into some kind of tale. Seemed like a harmless enough hobby at first, but now the pages are piling up, and I keep catching glimpses of us. Or maybe it’s just me she’s writing about. Doesn’t matter much, I guess. I’ve been rough on her, sure, the way I am with everyone. But the way her eyes light up when she talks about the characters, like they’re real, it makes me wonder if maybe there’s more to this story than I’m seeing. Maybe it’s time to take a closer look, not as the hardcase I pretend to be, but as someone who might need to understand a little more.
